newsitem.title: USA: Bando McGlocklin restructuring wins nod.
newsitem.headline: Bando McGlocklin restructuring wins nod.

text.p: Bando McGlocklin Capital Corp said Tuesday its shareholders approved a restructuring of the company as a real estate investment trust (REIT) from a small business investment company.
It said holders approved resolutions allowing the company to proceed with the formation of InvestorsBank to serve the financial needs of its small business customers.

Despite the change to REIT status, chairman George Schonath told the annual meeting, "Our objectives remain the same: to finance small business and to maximize our shareholders' return on investment."
InvestorsBank, which is to open in the first quarter of 1997, will be able to make machinery and equipment loans and extend lines of credit in addition to making real estate loans to small business.
